english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese choice for a self-contained flat, especially when discussing renting or buying one.

exampleSentences.english: This apartment has two bedrooms, just right for our family.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個單位有兩間房，啱晒我哋一家人住。
